C3.1.note: Truthfulness and strategyproofness are analysed for the lower bounds on truthful rules; the main distortion and PF results are not strategic.

C3.2.note: The implicit utilitarian framework assumes agents report the ranking induced by their utilities.

C3.3.note: The reasons given (cognitive burden, privacy) concern why rankings rather than utilities are elicited, not why reports are sincere.
